question: In the fluidized-bed sewage sludge co-incineration, how was fly ash sampled: how often, for how long each time, and following which standard?
expect: every 4 min, each sampling lasting 2 min, based on U.S. EPA Method 5 (sec. 2.2)
rendered:
Document: "Co-Incineration of Real Municipal Sewage Sludge in a Fluidized Bed: Effects of the Coexistence of P, Fe, and Na on Agglomeration and Heavy Metal Emissions"

Fly ash was collected from the flue-gas sampling port every 4 min, with each sampling interval lasting 2 min. 

The sampling procedure was primarily based on the U.S. EPA sampling standard method 5.
